paragraphs.source_en: The Round Head paintings are mainly concentrated in the central part of the Tassili Plateau with a minor and rather scarce presence in the surrounding massifs of the Acacus and the Algerian Tadrart. Was the area of the greatest accumulation of paintings the birthplace of this art or are there other sites, outside this area, where the Round Heads are present in their, presumably, more primitive form? Soleilhavoup (2007: 31; 183) claims that the origins of the Round Heads are in the Tassili because they are most numerous there. The Halliers (1999) on the other hand state that the original area of this artistic tradition is the Djado massif in the northern Niger.

paragraphs.source_en: Artistic production is extremely old in Africa, starting with simple objects like personal ornaments. The evidence for early use of ornaments is a potential tool indicating incipient forms of art documented archaeologically, which consequently evolved into various artistic expressions such as the portable art and rock art. The oldest dated objects are two deliberately engraved ochre pieces from circa 75,000 years old levels at Blombos Cave, Western Cape, South Africa and the >55,000 year old incised ostrich egg shell from the Diepkloof shelter in the same province (Henshilwood et al. 2009). In Namibia the earliest figurative art was also recorded, namely painted stones representing animals and geometric forms from Apollo 11 Cave, dating to between circa 26,000 and 28,000 BP (Deacon & Deacon 1999).

paragraphs.source_en: In the Northern Cape Province in South Africa a slab bearing a fine line engraving of part of an animal was dated to 10,200 BP (Garlake 2002). In the eastern Africa the oldest engravings in the Nile Valley date probably to 16,000–15,000 BP (Huyge 2009) and in North Africa the earliest portable art, namely the engravings in the form of mouflon horns date to 20th millennium BP (Aumassip 2004). Any form of art within Africa, the Round Heads included, should therefore be considered not as an invention but as one of many artistic manifestations with very ancient roots.
